description: The stages of a hire as the Moonbeam Protocol whitepaper defines them and this layer implements them: listing → intent → bid → terms → escrow → delivery → verdict → settlement → record → price — for each, who acts, the ERC-8183 events, the operations that perform it, and what Jev is asked. Read this first to know which tool belongs to which stage.
